# attestinfer
> Ed25519-signed (or HMAC-tagged) receipts binding model, policy, prompt-Merkle-root, output hash and timestamp, with salted, domain-separated Merkle selective disclosure of prompt chunks, in Zig 0.16. Not zero-knowledge; does not prove a model ran.

- CLI: `keygen <seed_file>`, `pubkey`, `sign <seed_file> <model> <policy> <root> <output>`, `verify <pubkey> ... <ts> <sig>` (Ed25519; no built-in key).
- Library: `signEd25519`/`verifyEd25519` (public), `signAttestation`/`verifyAttestation` (shared-key HMAC), `hashChunk`, `buildMerkleRoot`, `merkleProof`, `verifyInclusion`.
- C API `libattestinfer` (HMAC + `attestinfer_ed25519_sign/verify`), Python `python/attestinfer.py`.

README.md is the source of truth, including measured numbers with hardware and commit.
